description: Configuration include file defining tuning options for different Octeon processors in a Yocto Project build environment. It sets build variables, requires other config files, and specifies compiler arguments and architecture-specific features for Octeon2 and Octeon3 variants.

methods.name: bb.utils.contains
methods.description: Utility method used to check if a feature string contains a specific feature, used here to conditionally append compiler flags.
